primary_anchor_zh: 长椅位于圆形石喷泉左侧
story_reason_zh: 长椅被移去清洁，随后放回喷泉左侧

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型木长椅在阳光庭院的圆形石喷泉旁，保持静置。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 长椅位于圆形石喷泉左侧占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 庭院管理员利用隐藏小滚轮缓慢将长椅向右推出画面；随后呈现圆形喷泉及其左侧空地。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 庭院管理员利用隐藏小滚轮缓慢将长椅向右推出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 圆形喷泉及其左侧空地

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢将长椅推回画面并停在圆形喷泉左侧
shot_design.main_action_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢将长椅推回画面并停在圆形喷泉左侧
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 恢复长椅位于圆形石喷泉左侧，参照物保持清楚可见。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a broad wooden bench to the left of a round stone fountain in a sunlit courtyard. The bench remains still.

A fixed wide shot shows a broad wooden bench to the left of a round stone fountain in a sunlit courtyard. A groundskeeper slowly rolls the bench to the right on small concealed casters until it leaves the frame. The fixed camera then holds on the round stone fountain and the empty ground to its left. The fountain surface ripples gently.

A fixed wide shot holds on the round stone fountain and the empty ground to its left. A groundskeeper slowly rolls a broad wooden bench back into frame and stops it to the left of the round stone fountain.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 庭院管理员利用隐藏小滚轮缓慢将长椅向右推出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 圆形喷泉及其左侧空地
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 庭院管理员缓慢将长椅推回画面并停在圆形喷泉左侧
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
